basic_info.description: Rarely Available and Pristine 1BR/1BA at The Potrero!    Welcome to your new home! This exceptional 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offers the perfect blend of modern living in a serene setting. Bask in the abundance of natural light streaming through the large living room window, offering picturesque courtyard views. The open floor plan seamlessly integrates the open kitchen, living, and dining areas, highlighted by beautifully refinished maple hardwood flooring throughout.    For culinary enthusiasts, the chef's kitchen is a dream come true, featuring granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, including a 4-burner gas range. The spacious bedroom includes a convenient office nook and dual closets, one of which is a walk-in, providing ample storage space. The contemporary bathroom features a shower over the tub for your relaxation.    Convenience is key with in-unit laundry and one-car garage parking, complete with the potential to add an electric charger. Nestled quietly on the courtyard side of the building, you'll enjoy access to fantastic amenities, including a gym, communal courtyard, rooftop deck, and craft room.    Great Potrero location, walk to Whole Foods and the shops restaurants along 18th st. Close to public transportation, tech shuttles and EZ freeway access
